LightningComponentBundle.description: Renders the current object at the center of a diagram with connected Boundary Applications as surrounding nodes, colored by criticality with edges styled by direction. Click a node to open that record. A lightweight custom SVG layout, no charting library.

property.name: fieldApiName
property.label: Field API Name (optional)
property.description: Narrow the graph to applications connected to a single field on this record's object. Leave blank to show every application connected to the object.

property.name: objectApiName
property.label: Object API Name
property.description: The API name of the Salesforce object to center the graph on, e.g. Account or a custom object such as Invoice__c.
